documentTitle: Matcha On Ice Cafe — Syrups & Cold Foam

sections.label: Syrups
sections.blurb: The flavored syrups behind every Signature Matcha, made in-house.

drinks.name: Vanilla Syrup
method: Step 1: Combine the ingredients in a saucepan.
Step 2: Bring to a simmer, stirring until fully dissolved.
Step 3: Remove from heat and let cool completely.
Step 4: Strain, bottle and refrigerate.
